result: The authors demonstrate that recombinant Ym1 and Ym2 crystals produced in vitro are structurally equivalent to native crystals isolated from mice. Crystallographic analysis showed that native and recombinant crystals share the same monoclinic space group (P21) and unit-cell parameters for both Ym1 and Ym2, and that Ym1 and Ym2 crystals are structurally similar to each other.
evaluation: Multiple reviewers explicitly praised the crystallographic work as a major strength. Reviewer 1 stated 'Resolving the crystal structure of Ym2 and the comparison between native and recombinant CLP crystals is a strength of this manuscript' and 'Generation of the crystal structure for Ym2 is a particular strength.' Reviewer 2 noted 'The data are extremely high quality, clearly presented.' No concerns were raised about the crystallographic findings.

result: Ym1 crystals, but not soluble Ym1, induced innate immune responses in mouse airways including influx of monocytes and eosinophils, production of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNFα, IL-1β, IL-33) and chemokines (CCL2, CCL24). Soluble Ym1 crystallized in vivo after injection, forming smaller crystals in lower numbers than pre-formed crystals, potentially explaining reduced inflammation.
evaluation: Reviewers explicitly affirmed these findings. Reviewer 1 stated 'The ability to recombinantly generate CLP crystals and study their function in vivo and ex vivo has provided a robust dataset whereby CLPs can activate innate immune responses.' The editor noted 'The data presented are compelling' regarding Ym1 crystals' ability to promote type 2 immunity. No concerns were raised about the innate immunity data.

result: Ym1 crystals activated and recruited dendritic cells to lung-draining lymph nodes. Crystal exposure increased numbers of conventional DCs (particularly cDC2s) and monocytes, enhanced antigen uptake, and upregulated costimulatory molecules CD80 and CD86, with effects most pronounced for crystalline versus soluble Ym1.
evaluation: Reviewer 1 explicitly stated that the data demonstrate CLPs 'aid activation and trafficking of antigen presenting cells from the lymph node to the lung.' The reviewer noted 'The data presented flows logically and formulates a well constructed overall picture.' No methodological concerns were raised about the DC activation experiments.

result: Ym1 crystals, but not soluble Ym1, induced proliferation and accumulation of adoptively transferred OVA-specific OT-II T cells in lymph nodes and lungs. The T cells became Th2-polarized effector cells expressing CD44 and losing CD62L.
evaluation: Reviewer 1 affirmed that the data show CLPs 'further enhances type 2 immunity' and stated 'By demonstrating these effects the authors directly address the aims for the study.' The reviewer praised the logical flow of data. No concerns were raised about the T cell proliferation experiments.

result: Mice sensitized with OVA and Ym1 crystals developed allergic type 2 airway inflammation with eosinophil, B cell, and T cell influx, increased type 2 cytokines (IL-5, IL-10, IL-13), and robust OVA-specific IgG1 responses. This effect was specifically related to the crystalline state of Ym1.
evaluation: The editor stated 'This is an important and interesting account of the ability of Ym1 crystals to promote type 2 immunity in vivo, in mice. The data presented are compelling.' Reviewer 2 noted 'The data are extremely high quality, clearly presented, significantly extending previous work.' No concerns were raised about the type 2 inflammation findings.

result: Ym1 crystals did not elicit IgG1 antibodies in the OVA asthma model, but induced Ym1-specific IgM antibodies when administered intraperitoneally, suggesting potential autoimmune or natural IgM responses and intrinsic adjuvant activity of crystalline Ym1.
evaluation: Reviewers did not raise concerns about these antibody response findings. The data are presented as part of the overall characterization of Ym1 crystal immunogenicity, which reviewers praised as 'compelling' and 'high quality.' The distinction between IgM and IgG1 responses in different contexts was not questioned.

result: The authors speculate that Ym2 crystals will likely stimulate innate and adaptive immunity similar to Ym1 crystals, based on structural similarity, though this was not experimentally demonstrated.
evaluation: Both reviewers noted this limitation. Reviewer 1 stated 'It would have been nice for the authors to confirm whether Ym2 has similar functions to Ym1 using the in vivo and in vitro systems. However, they have discussed these points and raised it as a potential for future studies.' Reviewer 2 similarly noted 'It would be interesting to see if Ym2 crystals behave similarly to Ym1 crystals in vivo.' The speculation is accepted as reasonable but unproven.

result: The authors conclude that protein crystallization is a generalized feature of type 2 immunity, with CLCs and pseudo-CLCs sharing biological effects and being found almost exclusively in eosinophilic airway inflammation across species.
evaluation: The editor stated this work will be 'of relevant interest to immunologists and researchers working on type 2 inflammatory disease.' Reviewer 1 noted 'data presented in this paper is a major advance to the field' and praised the generation of 'a model in which crystal formation/function an important feature of human eosinophilic diseases, can be studied.' The broader conclusion about protein crystallization in type 2 immunity is implicitly supported by reviewers' enthusiasm.
